\chapter{Kikuchi LDC — High Value}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.KikuchiLDC.LDC.HighValue
\section{Overview}

This module records the high-value observation (Lemma 5.1) of the
Alrabiah--Guruswami--Kothari--Manohar near-cubic lower bound for $3$-query locally
decodable codes: if $C$ is $(3,\delta,\varepsilon)$-normally decodable, then the XOR
instances $\psi_b$ attached to $C$ have large value, $\E_b[\mathrm{val}(\psi_b)] \ge
2\varepsilon$. It is formalised here in the existential form asserting a single message
and assignment on which the XOR polynomial already reaches $2\varepsilon$.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Existence of a high-value assignment for the XOR polynomial]
\lean{high_value_observation}
\label{high_value_observation}
\leanok
\statementsource{arXiv.2308.15403}{pdf-b372a20892ce-p005-b010}
\uses{IsPMOne, NormalLDC, NormalLDC.totalConstraints, NormalLDC.xorPoly, assignment_prod}
\difficulty{3}
Let $L$ be a normal form $(3,\delta,\varepsilon)$-decodable code with message length $k
\ge 1$ and block length $n \ge 1$, and suppose its total number of constraints is
positive, $m \ge 1$. If the advantage parameter satisfies $\varepsilon \le 1/2$, then
there exist a message $b : \mathrm{Fin}\,k \to \bbz$ and an assignment $x :
\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbz$, each taking values in $\{-1, 1\}$, such that the XOR
polynomial of $L$ satisfies
\[
  \psi_b(x) \;\ge\; 2\varepsilon .
\]
\end{theorem}
